summary: Iteration 16 QA of Phase C — Fleet Management. Backend: 37/37 pytest cases pass in ~23s across 7 test classes covering (a) GET /api/fleet owner-only + 8-item inspection catalog + Truck 2 seeded state (needs_attention, mileage 84310, reg NJ-REG-1234 exp 2026-08-10 -> 'soon' amber, ins 2027-01-15 -> 'ok', reminders_due>=1, open_damage>=1, last_inspection.passed=false), (b) PATCH /api/trucks/{id} extended fields (mileage/fleet_status/registration/insurance/reminders) + invalid fleet_status -> 422 + regression name/plate/active still work + crew 403, (c) inspections: crew pass bumps mileage, crew fail flips fleet_status to needs_attention AND owner gets 'flag' notification 'Inspection flagged Truck 3', owner sees full history, crew limited to 5, sales/marketing (owner-switched roles) 403, (d) inspection->checklist integration on Montclair (unchecked warehouse item 0 -> filed inspection with assignment_id -> item auto-marked done + timeline 'Daily inspection filed for Truck 1' + exec_status stayed 'In Progress'), (e) truck-logs maintenance+fuel + invalid kind 422 + totals returned + crew 403 + DELETE, (f) damage: crew POST notifies owner, empty description 422, crew cannot list (403), owner list ok, open_damage reflected on fleet, resolve/reopen toggles, (g) photos: multipart image upload as crew, streaming works via ?auth= for owner+crew, sales 403, bad kind 422, non-image 422, photo id appears in inspection.photos list. Frontend: owner /fleet renders 5 fleet-truck-card, Truck 2 shows Needs attention select + 'Inspected today — issues' red badge + amber Reg exp Aug 10 2026 chip + '1 damage' + '1 due' badges. Truck detail dialog opens with 4 tabs (overview/logs/inspections/damage), all data-testids resolve (mileage-input, overview-save, reminder title/date/add, file-inspection-btn). Inspection dialog: 8 inspection-switch-{key} rows default ON, flipping brakes off turns row red and submit button flips from 'All good — file it' to 'File with 1 issue'. Crew view (Javante): 'Fleet' nav HIDDEN, direct /fleet redirects to /today, /jobs shows Montclair with BOTH 'Checklists' and 'Daily inspection' (job-inspection-btn) buttons. USER-REQUESTED INTEGRATION VERIFIED: expanded Warehouse Departure checklist -> unchecked 'Truck inspected' item 0 -> re-checking auto-opened inspection-dialog (titled 'Daily inspection — Truck 1') instead of plain check -> submitting all-pass filed the inspection and the checkbox landed in 'checked' state (auto-marked by backend). Iter15 regression: 22/23 still pass; the 1 failure (test_javante_scheduled_no_flag) is expected date-drift — ET today is 2026-07-26 while Montclair is on QA_DAY 2026-07-21, so Javante correctly flags 'not_scheduled_today'.

minor.issue: test_credentials.md documents Javante password 'JavCrew2026!' and Junior password 'JunCrew2026!' — these ARE valid via email-based login. Ghost accounts (TestSalesAdmin/TestMarketingAdmin/TestCrewAdmin) resolve to role='owner' at login (per shared APP_PASSWORD fallback). Not a bug per se, but tests that need real sales/crew/marketing RBAC must use /api/auth/switch-role from an owner token — documented in test file.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3244-3273 fleet_overview: single scan trucks then batched find on inspections+damage with $in — O(1) queries regardless of truck count. Good perf. _expiry_state 30-day 'soon' threshold matches Fleet.jsx ExpiryChip colors.

server.py L3283-3322 create_inspection: correctly (a) coerces items dict to canonical 8 keys, (b) only flips fleet_status if currently in_service (won't overwrite in_shop), (c) only bumps mileage if odometer > current (prevents rollback), (d) checklist auto-mark & timeline event gated by principal being on crew OR owner, (e) inspection is inserted BEFORE side-effects so notify/audit failures don't lose the record. Nice.

server.py L3316-3319 checklist auto-mark uses $set 'lists.warehouse_departure.items.0' — hard-coded to item index 0 by design (matches user-requested integration). Then _maybe_complete_checklist runs to advance job status if all 5 items now done.
server.py L3393-3414 report_damage: only notifies owner when reporter is non-owner (avoids self-notify). Description trimmed+capped 600. Good.
server.py L3446-3472 upload_truck_photo: 15MB cap, image/* content-type check, file extension derived from filename with fallback jpg. Storage failure returns 502 (not 500) — client can distinguish.
server.py L3475-3490 serve_truck_photo mounted on dl_router (not api_router). Accepts token via ?auth= query string — required for use case. Uses _require_fleet_actor so sales/marketing get 403.
server.py L2554-2587 patch_truck extended: preserves old fields correctly, uses $set only on provided keys, invalid fleet_status raises 422 with helpful message. Regression risk minimal.
Fleet.jsx L18-28 ExpiryChip: 'expired' red, 'soon' amber (<=30d), 'ok' slate — semantic colors + accessible via testId prop. Nice.

TruckDetailDialog.jsx L20-29 Overview form seeds from truck prop via useEffect on prop change — will overwrite in-flight local edits if load() refetches while user is editing. Minor UX concern; not a bug.
InspectionDialog.jsx: 8 switches default true, flipping to false triggers row red styling + submit label toggles to 'File with N issue(s)' — verified end-to-end in QA screenshot.
JobChecklists.jsx warehouse_departure item 0 intercept: verified — the RE-check gesture opens InspectionDialog rather than doing a plain check, per review-request user-requested integration. Elegant.

test_credentials.md consistency: passwords work via {email: ..., password: ...} login body (payload.email field). NOT {username: ...} — that falls through to shared APP_PASSWORD path which grants owner-role, hiding the real user identity. Testing agents beware.

success_rate.backend: 100% (37/37 iter16 pytest, 22.78s serial). Iter15 regression 22/23 (1 expected date-drift failure — not a bug).
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter16 data-testids verified: fleet-page/truck-card/status-select/open-truck/damage-badge/reminder-badge/reg-chip/ins-chip; truck-detail-dialog 4 tabs; inspection-dialog 8 switches + submit label toggle; crew /jobs job-inspection-btn + integration warehouse_departure item 0 -> inspection dialog; Fleet nav owner-only)

Iter15 test_javante_scheduled_no_flag now fails because ET today (2026-07-26) has drifted 5 days past QA_DAY (2026-07-21) — Montclair is no longer 'today' for Javante's scheduled clock-in check. Fix: either bump QA_DAY, or move Montclair job_date to today, or update the assertion to accept 'not_scheduled_today' when the job is in the past.
rca of the issue: No product bugs. Two ancillary findings: (1) Ghost accounts (TestSalesAdmin/TestMarketingAdmin/TestCrewAdmin) log in via shared APP_PASSWORD fallback and receive role='owner' tokens — this is by design per the auth flow (env var role passwords) but the review-request wording 'crew/sales 403' cannot be tested with those accounts. Use /api/auth/switch-role from owner. (2) Iter15's test_javante_scheduled_no_flag fails due to date drift: QA_DAY=2026-07-21 pinned assignments are now 5 days in the past relative to ET-today 2026-07-26, so Javante's clock-in correctly gets flagged 'not_scheduled_today'. Semantic test fix needed, not a code fix.
